description: This plot illustrates the comparison of "Eval PPL." across varying "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" for four different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and features a reversed linear scale decreasing from 100 to 25, with visible tick marks at 100, 75, and 25, and an obscured tick mark (covered by a grey rectangle) positioned halfway between 75 and 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and uses a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines. The "Transformer" configuration is represented by a red dashed line without markers, which remains constant at a value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis range. The "Only MoHD FFN" configuration is shown as a solid grey line with square markers; it begins at approximately 11.45 at an x-value of 100, decreases slightly to roughly 11.3 at the obscured third tick mark, and then rises to end at approximately 11.8 at an x-value of 25. The "Only MoHD ATTN" configuration is depicted by a solid dark blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 11.45 at an x-value of 100, increasing to roughly 12.25 at the obscured third tick mark, and reaching a peak of approximately 14.3 at an x-value of 25. Finally, the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configuration is represented by a solid light blue line with 'x' markers, which starts at approximately 11.45 at an x-value of 100, rises to roughly 12.05 at the obscured third tick mark, and concludes at approximately 13.2 at an x-value of 25.
